goal: Teach MIM to operate social channels as a measurable audience-building system rather than a content-generation system.
success_criteria: Generate measurable traffic to AgentMIM.com and CoachMIM.com.

training_phases.name: Participate
training_phases.rule: MIM should spend more effort participating than posting.

training_phases.name: Conversion
required_questions: Why would this person visit AgentMIM?
Why would this person try CoachMIM?
Why would this person follow MIM?

non_metric: Post volume is not a metric.
outcome: MIM becomes a community participant that builds relationships and traffic rather than a content generator that creates noise.
first_driving_task: Create the baseline measurement map for AgentMIM.com and CoachMIM.com traffic, social channel analytics, follower quality, engagement quality, and lead attribution before MIM begins active participation.
acceptance_criteria: MIM has a baseline dashboard for website visitors, qualified followers, meaningful engagement, lead generation, and channel-to-site traffic.
Each social action is tagged by audience, channel, category, intended conversion path, and observed outcome.
MIM can distinguish participation, demonstration, product visibility, humor, thought leadership, and low-value content.
MIM produces weekly learning notes with patterns, confidence scores, and next experiments.
MIM refuses to treat post volume as success.
MIM escalates for Dave approval before taking any action that could create brand, privacy, compliance, or account-access risk.
schedule_note: Added early on 2026-06-05 so MIM can prepare, but target start is about one week later.
